newsitem.title: USA: Play-By-Play warns on safety of toy.
newsitem.headline: Play-By-Play warns on safety of toy.

text.p: Play-By-Play Toys & Novelties Inc said consumers who bought its stuffed polar bear holding a small plastic replica of a Coca-Cola bottle should dispose of the bottle.
Play-By-Play said it decided to take the action after test results by a customer indicated the bottle might crack or break when dropped or subjected to extraordinary force.
It said the warning applies to toys bought before October 15, 1996.
Consumers can send the 12-inch bear to the company for a replacement or cut the threads holding the bottle in place, Play-By-Play said.
It said the toy had passed all safety tests prior to distribution. It said it was not aware of any injuries involving the product.
The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission has conducted its own testing of the product and determined that the product meets safety requirements, the company said.
